transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net mobile support, my name is Latoya. How may I assist you today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hello Latoya. I've just landed in Barcelona on a business trip, and my mobile data has completely stopped working. I can't use maps or access my work emails.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I can certainly look into that roaming data restriction and get your connection restored, Eamon. Could I take your mobile number, please?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, it is 07700 900631, registered under Eamon Kelly.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you, Eamon. For account security, could you please confirm your full UK billing address and your memorable security question answer?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, 12 Malone Heights, Belfast, BT9 6PQ. And the security question answer is Stranmillis.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's verified your account, thank you. You are on our S-Net Unlimited 5G Max tariff with Roam-Abroad included.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, which is supposed to include European roaming.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: So to make sure I understand the situation clearly: you arrived in Spain today on a business trip, your phone has signal bars for making standard voice calls and texts, but mobile cellular data is completely failing to load any internet traffic, is that right?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Exactly. I'm standing outside Terminal 1 waiting for a corporate client, I don't know the exact street address of our conference venue, and I cannot load Google Maps or access my calendar. It's really stressful.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Being stranded outside an overseas airport without navigation or email access is awful, Eamon, and I am very sorry for that stress. Let's get your data bearer connection sorted out immediately so you can reach your venue.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you Latoya, I really appreciate your help. It was quite scary standing here with no connectivity.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let's probe your device cellular settings first to rule out any handset overrides. On your iPhone settings menu, under Cellular Data, is the Data Roaming slider toggled to the green 'On' position?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Let me open Settings, then Cellular Data... yes, the Data Roaming toggle switch is definitely turned green and active.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Good, thank you. And which Spanish host network provider is currently displayed at the very top of your handset screen? Is it Movistar, Orange, or Vodafone ES?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: It says 'Movistar' in the top status bar, showing four out of four signal bars, but with a persistent little exclamation mark next to the 4G symbol.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That exclamation mark indicates the Movistar base station is rejecting your cellular data authentication packet. Bear with me for a moment while I pull up your roaming provisioning file on our core network subscriber database.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Sure thing, thank you.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for holding, Eamon. I have found the root cause immediately on our Home Location Register.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: What was the issue, Latoya?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: When your contract upgraded last month, an international roaming data bar was erroneously left active on the wholesale APN profile on our home location register. It allowed domestic cellular data across the UK network but automatically rejected foreign network data handshakes.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Ah, so my account was blocking data abroad from your end, even though my tariff includes EU roaming?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, precisely. It was a provisioning flag mismatch in our wholesale gateway. I have just manually stripped off that roaming data bar, updated your international user profile, and pushed an immediate network refresh directly to your SIM card.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Brilliant. Do I need to restart the handset, or just reset the connection?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Before you restart, let's verify your Access Point Name settings so that the phone requests the correct roaming gateway when it reboots. Sometimes new SIM cards default to an older generic APN that doesn't route European roaming traffic correctly.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay, where do I find the APN settings?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Go to Settings, Mobile Data, Mobile Data Network. Under the APN field, does it say 'everywhere' or 'general.t-mobile.uk'?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: It says 'everywhere', all in lowercase, and the username is 'eesecure'.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That is the correct S-Net partner APN. Now, please switch on Airplane Mode for about ten seconds, and then turn Airplane Mode back off.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Airplane Mode on... waiting five seconds... and Airplane Mode off. It's searching for network now.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: It will re-negotiate authentication with the Movistar base station using your updated profile permissions.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Signal bars are back... it says 'Movistar 5G'... and the exclamation mark has disappeared! A little 5G icon is showing with up and down arrows!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Just to verify now that the data bearer has established, are your incoming WhatsApp notifications and emails pinging through?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes! Three WhatsApp messages just arrived and my work inbox just synced fifteen emails. It's pouring in!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Could you also open Google Maps and search for your hotel to confirm the mapping data downloads smoothly without Wi-Fi?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Opening Google Maps now... typed in Hotel Arts Barcelona... route loaded instantly, satellite view is crisp, and navigation is ready!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: So to confirm, Eamon, the roaming data bar has been permanently removed, high-speed 5G data is active, and your navigation and work apps are fully functioning?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, 100 percent resolved. You have completely saved my business trip, Latoya. I was genuinely panicking out here.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I'm delighted we could get you back online so quickly. I have also verified that your roaming data fair-usage cap is set to the full 50 gigabytes allowance.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That's plenty for the three days I'm here. Really good to know.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And whenever you travel to other European countries in future, the profile will now automatically roam onto local partner networks without any bars.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Fantastic. That saves having to phone up every time.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Is there anything else with your mobile tariff, roaming bundle or overseas calling that I can help you with today, Eamon?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: No, that's everything sorted. You've been exceptional Latoya, thank you.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: It was my absolute pleasure, Eamon. I am also sending you a complimentary roaming summary text message that includes direct international dialling codes, Spanish emergency numbers, and our overseas priority customer helpline numbers, just to keep in your phone notes.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Very useful to have those direct contact numbers stored in my phone. I've just received that confirmation text message now.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: If you ever find yourself in a rural area outside Barcelona with patchy signal, remember you can also go into Settings, Mobile Data, and manually select Orange ES or Vodafone ES under Network Selection.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That is a great tip. I might be traveling out to a manufacturing client in Girona tomorrow, so having secondary network options is really handy.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Both of those networks are Tier-1 S-Net roaming partners across the Iberian peninsula, so you will receive the exact same 5G high-speed connectivity and unlimited data allowance without any roaming surcharges.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Superb. Really comprehensive and reassuring support today, Latoya. I couldn't have asked for better service.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I am so pleased we got everything running smoothly before your client meeting. Is there anything else at all I can assist you with before you head into town?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: No, that covers absolutely everything. My taxi has just pulled up to the kerb now.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Have a wonderful stay in Catalonia, Eamon, and best of luck with your business presentations today.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you Latoya, have a great day ahead!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for choosing S-Net, Eamon. Safe travels and take care.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thanks again for all your help. Goodbye!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for choosing S-Net, have a wonderful day. Goodbye.
